content.short: Society incubator that runs month-long pop-up villages for people at the frontier of tech and science.
content.description: Edge City brings together a few hundred builders, researchers and artists to live and work in one place for a month, and funds them with grants and fellowships. At Edge City Patagonia it ran an experiment with World: around 500 of the 750 residents used World App, 33 shops in San Martín de los Andes accepted it, and more than $44,000 moved through the system. It also backs Crecimiento, an effort to turn Argentina into a tech hub.
content.meta: Edge City runs month-long pop-up villages for frontier builders, including a World App payments trial in Patagonia.
